column1: The cricket match last night was absolutely thrilling till the final ball.
My phone screen cracked the very first day I bought it.
The new cafe near campus serves the best filter coffee I have tasted.
The exam paper was unfair and nothing from the syllabus was asked.
I really enjoyed the guest lecture on robotics this morning.
The train was cancelled without any announcement and we were stranded.
Our hostel warden was very kind and helped me when I was sick.
The online portal crashed right before the assignment deadline.
